description: This file defines the Connection class in the OrangeHRM installer utility, responsible for establishing and managing the database connection using Doctrine DBAL. It implements singleton pattern, initializes database connection parameters, registers Doctrine type mappings, and provides methods to retrieve and reset the connection.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Manages the database connection for OrangeHRM installer, implementing singleton pattern to ensure a single shared connection instance. Initializes connection parameters from system state and registers type mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the database connection using parameters fetched from the system state, registers 'enum' type mapping, and logs system details.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection, initializing it if not already established.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stored connection, allowing for reinitialization.
